answer: Divergent-nonce orchard: each agent’s vault holds a unique PRNG seed; an inlet service issues overlapping challenge IDs. Agents publish commitments to seed-derived nonces. Clones sharing a vault seed emit identical commitments on any overlapping inlet, so the orchard flags duplicate lineage. Evasion requires per-clone HSM/RNG entropy and disjoint nonce scheduling, raising marginal cost near independent-agent levels and creating detectable timing anomalies.
